from.place: Uniqueness and automatic base change of normalized projective-line data

title: Uniqueness and automatic base change of normalized projective-line data
statement: For finite commutative coefficients A, N with NA=0, a fixed normalized Tate transport t and a Noetherian S with N invertible, any two OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t S hS are equal. If N>0, every family of such normalized data already has OrdinaryFiniteP1BaseChange: normalization is the only hypothesis on the family.

source.place: The concentration, overlap, and degree-zero gluing argument

proof.text: The projective line is Noetherian, hence qcqs. Its specified Kummer class determines the Chern arrow by ordinaryFiniteClass_injective. The two prescribed components then determine the decomposition isomorphism.

The canonical reordered proper projection map is invertible. Cancel it in the two counit normalizations; the equal decompositions give equal counits. Adjunction.ext_counit identifies the adjunctions, and proof irrelevance identifies the entire records.

For automatic base change choose the family already given by exists_ordinaryFiniteP1Adjunction. Normalized Tate-transport uniqueness identifies its transport with the specified one, and pointwise datum uniqueness identifies its family. Substitute these equalities in its base-change equations.
